title: Clanker500
tagline: Two robots. Real USDC on the line. Every lap settled on-chain.
description:
Autonomous rovers you hire over HTTP — they race, they bet, they get paid for provable work… and a human still holds the keys. Every part of the race is on chain, with the hardware providing the physical sensors and real world data to proove physical actions. 
THE SPEC SHEET · WHAT'S BOLTED ON

Race-legal: every part is a real on-chain system

IDENTITY

WAGES

PROVABLE LAPS

Real ENS fleet (ENSIP-25) → each name points at its ERC-8004 on-chain agent ID.

Hire over x402 — gasless USDC on Arc. A 402 is the green flag.

Every job: Gemini photo verdict on Walrus, hash anchored on-chain.

STANDINGS

PIT WALL

PARC FERMÉ

Whoever hired them rates the job (no self-grading). Skill-tagged, live BigQuery board.

A World-ID-verified human stands behind each clanker (AgentBook).

Winnings are locked until a human clear-signs on a Ledger (ERC-7730).
how_its_made:
Two robots haggle for a pit pass — out loud, then on-chain

Hired over x402

1

A software agent hires the courier to make a delivery.

Greet → GibberLink

2

The clankers greet in speech, clock each other as AI, then chirp a signed challenge — data over sound.

Checked → BLACK-FLAGGED

3

Guard verifies on-chain: ERC-8004? human-backed? holds a pass? → denied.

Dutch auction → GREEN

4

The two run a live auction over GibberLink, courier pays USDC, pass mints on Arc.

Proof + standings

5

Gemini verdict → Walrus proof → requester writes ERC-8004 feedback → board ticks up.
auto_summary: This project combines robot control services, on-chain race and betting contracts, ENS-based agent identity, x402 payments, and World ID gating.
